note: Both sets suffer from significant binding errors due to OCR misalignment (e.g., attributing 50's conduit to 150, 31's spec to 32, mixing conductor sizes). However, Set B correctly identifies the conductor material for Symbol 150 as AL (matching the image), whereas Set A assigns this to Symbol 151 (following the text layer error). Set B also extracts the 'ARMORED CABLE' type which Set A misses. Set B correctly identifies Symbol 20's material as CU, while Set A is less explicit. Both sets incorrectly assign properties between rows, but Set B is slightly more faithful to the image's symbol numbering for the AL/Armored entry.
